description: Apply Tree Normal Form enumeration with early termination heuristics based on transition graph topology. Machines with disconnected state graphs or trivially looping structures are pruned before simulation begins.
mathematical_formalization: TNF(n,k) = {M : M is in tree normal form with n states and k symbols, G(M) is connected}
implementation_hypothesis: Implement TNF enumeration with graph connectivity checks; prune machines whose transition graph has isolated states or self-loops on all transitions
experiment_seed: Count TNF-valid 6-state machines vs total; measure fraction pruned by connectivity
